picks.title: Build by Design: New workflows for new ways of building
picks.rationale: New Config India design-system features (guidelines on libraries, GitHub/npm code-source import so the Figma agent builds on-pattern) directly change how system teams set up agent work.
picks.excerpt: Figma's Config India recap: beyond code layers and Specs, design systems can now carry guidelines and import code sources from a GitHub repo or npm package so agents build and edit components that follow the team's patterns, plus a preview of a single home for all system libraries.

picks.title: Create, ship, and manage data-backed websites with Payload in Figma
picks.rationale: Payload headless CMS now built into Figma Make gives designers a real backend and content management from prototype to production -- a concrete new capability.
picks.excerpt: Payload, the open-source headless CMS whose team joined Figma, is now built into Figma Make so teams can build and host sites and apps with a built-in backend and manage content and data from prototype to production.

picks.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Speed Agentic Creation
picks.rationale: Official Adobe-NVIDIA announcement: Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D optimized for RTX Spark (up to 2x faster AI editing) plus cloud acceleration for Frame.io and Brand Concierge.
picks.excerpt: Adobe is optimizing its agentic creative apps Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D for NVIDIA's RTX Spark superchip, claiming up to 2x faster AI processing, editing, color and effects, and accelerating Frame.io and Brand Concierge in the cloud.

picks.title: The AI experience doesn't care about your org chart
picks.rationale: Argues content design, knowledge management and model behavior are merging into one AI experience and DesignOps must reorganize -- a fresh structural take for design leads.
picks.excerpt: Kate Agena argues AI is merging content design, enterprise content strategy, knowledge management and model behavior into one user experience, and DesignOps ways of working haven't caught up.

picks.title: Is Your Organization Messing Up AI Adoption?
picks.rationale: Paul Boag maps digital-transformation lessons onto AI adoption in design teams, naming the mistakes orgs are repeating -- credible, practical guidance from a new outlet for the set.
picks.excerpt: Paul Boag revisits his book Digital Adaptation to show how lessons from digital transformation apply to AI adoption in design and digital teams, and where organizations are repeating the same mistakes.

https://www.figma.com/blog/build-by-desi.new_action: New design-system features announced at Config India: guidelines attached to published libraries, code-source import from GitHub/npm for the Figma agent, and a preview of a unified library home (code layers and Specs, already published 10-16/10-17, are not the hook).

https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/adobe.new_action: Separate Adobe-NVIDIA partnership release (10-15): Photoshop/Premiere/Substance 3D RTX Spark optimization with up to 2x AI speedups, plus cloud acceleration of Frame.io and Brand Concierge.
